inputs.label: Quake (original, not the rerelease)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Quake from Steam, GOG or Bethesda. QGPUI uses the original id1 folder, not rerelease/id1.

steps.why: The first launch creates /sdcard/QuakeQuest/id1 and copies the shareware pak0.pak, which the push then replaces.
pak0.pak alone is the shareware game; pak1.pak shows the full game is there.

notes: The GOG and Bethesda install folder names are guesses. A shareware pak0.pak and the full one have the same name, so verify must include pak1.pak.
